title: Add scan-time CodeQL path exclusions for non-owned directories

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Adding .github/codeql/codeql-config.yml with scan-time paths-ignore for non-owned build/vendor/cache directories so CodeQL avoids extracting/scanning them in the first place.
